value.rationale: The natural noncommutative rank-one projector conjugacy orbit has a complete ordered additive two-sum distribution on all odd prime-power rings at depths >=2. The singular p-adic norm strata give new structural arithmetic, an exact global fourth Fourier moment, and a sharp depth-independent probability minorization with an exceptional residue prime p=3. This is a motivated complete classification and quantitative harmonic invariant, not a narrow unmotivated table or solely the existence of sums.
